name: @pipeworx/mcp-japan-law

tools.name: search_laws
tools.description: TITLE SEARCH ONLY (not full-text): finds Japanese national laws, cabinet orders, and ministerial ordinances whose TITLE matches a keyword (e-Gov 法令検索). PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Japanese law on X", "日本の法律", finding a statute's official id/number. A query that only appears in the body of a law (not its title) will not match. Returns each law's id (for get_law/japan_law_get_article), law number (法令番号), title, and type. Accepts Japanese or romanized keywords.

query.description: Title keyword, e.g. "個人情報" (personal information), "労働基準" (labor standards).

tools.name: get_law
tools.description: Fetch a Japanese law/ordinance by its e-Gov law id (from search_laws), e.g. "415AC0000000057". Returns the title, law number, promulgation date, and the law's full text, PAGED — use `offset`/`limit` to walk a long law; `has_more`/`next_offset` say whether another page follows. For a single article (incl. branch articles like 第二十七条の2), use japan_law_get_article instead — it is far cheaper than paging a whole law to find one provision. Pass `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch the version of the law in force on that date. Source: e-Gov 法令検索.

as_of.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the revision in force on that date instead of the current one.

offset.description: Character offset into the full text to start this page at (default 0).

limit.description: Max characters to return in this page (default 30000, max 60000).

tools.name: japan_law_get_article
tools.description: Fetch a single article of a Japanese law by law id + article number, e.g. law_id "415AC0000000057" (個人情報保護法) + article "27" for 第二十七条. Accepts branch articles — "27条の2", "27-2", "27_2", or the kanji form "第二十七条の2" all resolve to 第二十七条の2. Returns just that article's caption, heading, and text (not the whole law — use this instead of get_law when you know the article you want). Pass `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch the article text as it stood on that date, before or after a given amendment. Source: e-Gov 法令検索.

article.description: Article number: "27", "27条の2", "27-2", "27_2", or kanji "第二十七条の2".

as_of.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the article text in force on that date instead of the current one.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-japan-law forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the japan-law pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
